svg.title: Sequence — a normal turn (human plays a Clan card, claims, draws)

g.text: Sequence — a normal turn (human plays a Clan card, claims, draws)
click a Clan card in hand
highlight the Stones listed by PC.values(STONE)
reject if the actor is virtual
human to act: nothing to do
press "End turn" (choose a deck if several)
schedule act() after the AI delay
